response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Clears the 11-scan mark" means scancount strictly greater than 11 (> 11, not >= 11).
Ties in average compression ratio at the 10-row cutoff are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-break rule.
